newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan April-June output seen up 0.2 pct qtr/qtr.
newsitem.headline: Japan April-June output seen up 0.2 pct qtr/qtr.

text.p: Japan's industrial output for April to June period is expected to rise 0.2 percent quarter-on-quarter, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Tuesday.
On a year-on-year basis, output in the quarter was projected to grow 6.8 percent from the same year-ago period, a MITI official said.
Following the release of Japan's revised May industrial output figures, a MITI official told reporters, "There is no change in our view. Production is generally on a gradual upward trend."
